node.title: Structural Awareness — Cross-Agent Residual Intersection and Online Opportunity
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 1. De Morgan and the shared blind spot · 2. From a joint residual property to a near-optimality proof · 3. Nonempty mathematical region, observed candidate, and reachable action are separate.

relations: A nonempty shared region does not itself prove generative value; the link from the joint property to a usable capability must be established separately.
Comparación conceptual entre dominios; la geometría sintética no valida una institución o una integración real.
